name: interior column loss
definition_zh: 框架内部柱丧失承载或约束作用的情景。
usage_overview: 用作框架抗连续倒塌分析中的局部支承丧失工况，考察内部柱失去支承作用后，相邻梁板如何重新传递荷载。

complete_examples.text: Q. Zhang, et al. collapse resistance of RC framed structures under an interior column loss are proposed.

P042.title: Simplified model for assessing progressive collapse resistance of reinforced concrete frames under an interior column loss
P042.authors: Q Zhang, YG Zhao, K Kolozvari, L Xu
P042.label: Zhang等（2020）

contexts.text: 论文采用的局部支承丧失工况，触发相邻梁板重新传力。
